title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: The DataFrame 'dishes' contains information about attendees, their dishes, servings, course type, and phone numbers. We need to filter this DataFrame based on a specific condition related to phone numbers.

title: Filtering Based on Phone Numbers
text: To filter rows in a DataFrame based on a condition, we can use the DataFrame's column and apply a string method to check if the condition is met.

title: Using String Methods
text: The 'str' accessor in pandas allows us to apply string methods to each element in a column. For example, 'str.startswith()' checks if a string starts with a specified prefix.

title: Applying the Filter
text: Use the 'str.startswith()' method to filter the DataFrame for phone numbers starting with '510'.

title: Alternative Method
text: Another way to filter is by checking the first three characters of the phone number using slicing.

title: Using Split Method
text: You can also split the phone number by '-' and check if the first part is '510'.
